_doc: Measured text budgets per box variant (phase 5 width gate), read by tools/lint.py. px = sum of the half-width VWF advances (engine.half_widths) of the line; English is plain ASCII drawn with the half-width font (window font mode 3). status: measured (with the shot) or guess.

dialogue.what: script archive message body: the speaker box with a portrait (text from x=40); the engine pages every 2 lines, a blank line forces a new page, the page arrow sits at the right end of the 2nd line
dialogue.shot: map_290 with build.py --qa 34.10=...: 130 x I clipped at x=232 (pen 192); arrow at x=225-230 on line 2 (work/qa/torture3, work/qa/torture5)

name_tag.what: first line of a script archive message (speaker); the tag box grows with the byte count, about 6 px per byte from x=8
name_tag.shot: map_290, 'Baron Ashura (Male) Professor Kuruma' (36 bytes) fits, box ends at x=229 (work/qa/tag)

item_list.what: item menu list name field (8x8 font, 8-px VWF): from the name's x to the count graphic; both columns
item_list.shot: m1_item marker build: left name x=25, count x=96; right name x=136, count x=205 (work/qa/v8_m1_item); also the shop list (m2_shop, same window 0200AE80). Lint: every rec18 string (tools/fields.py TABLES)

equip_list.what: status screen equipment picker (A on an equipment slot): rec18 name (8x8 font, 8-px VWF) from x=152 to the count at x=224; the equipped slot bar shows the same name from x=152 with more room
equip_list.shot: m1_status JP build after A (work/qa/st_jp/run/f000090.png): name x=152, '99' ink from x=224; marker build 'DD258:abcdef' (72 px) runs into the count (work/qa/st1/f000090.png)

battle_name.what: battle party status row: battler name (8x8 font, 8-px VWF) from x=90 to the HP gauge at x=144
battle_name.shot: o_battle marker build: 'DB800:abcdefghi' from x=90, HP gauge from x=144 (work/qa/fields/shots/o_battle.png, tools/lua/fieldprobe.lua w=0200E300 pen x=2)

book.what: character book (script/book, キャラ図鑑): name line, 2 blank lines, description; inserted as fullwidth Latin and drawn with the 12-px font (engine.widths), pen 0 at x=128, clipped at x=236
book.status: measured (px); lines = the JP's most (name + 2 blank + 4)
book.shot: m1_book marker build: 'B00.00 The quick' cut inside the k (pen 103-110) at x=236 (work/qa/marker_book)

desc.what: item / skill description (script/desc): the one-line box at the screen bottom, half-width font, pen 0 at x=12
desc.status: measured in the book's skill list; the item menu and battle readers (0x0808827C, 0x0809A45C) not yet seen
desc.shot: m1_book marker build: 'D01.13 The quick brown fox jumps over the la' cut in the a (pen 220) at x=236 (work/qa/marker_book)

skill_list.what: battle skill list (スキル window, w=0200E850, drawn by 0x080863E8 -> 0x0800E3D0): the skill's second name copy (8x8 font, 8-px VWF) from x=24 to the DP column; a 2-digit DP starts at x=97
skill_list.shot: game_over marker build, frame 2708: 'DC7DC:abcdef' (72 px) ink x=24-94, DP '12' from x=97 (work/qa/skf_m/f002708.png). The window opens at ~2700: a shot at 2696-2700 shows it empty (not a bug)

skill_party.what: party / assort screen (アソート変更, m1_party / m2_sparty) skill rows: 8x8 font, 8-px VWF, from x=136 to the fixed rank icon at x=215. Which name copy it shows is not known (every marker skill seen had one string for both), so both are checked. The status screen's Select skill list (name x=20, 1-digit DP at x=105) has more room than the battle list
skill_party.shot: m1_party marker build after route (work/qa/sh_m1_party/run/f000480.png): 'DC7DC:abcdef' from x=136, icon at x=214; JP build same route: icon at x~216 (work/qa/party_jp.png); status skill list work/qa/st2/f000290.png

place_name.what: save / load slot 現在地 field (script/place, map names): half-width font, pen 0 at x=120, the box interior ends at x=234
place_name.shot: m1_save marker build after saving to slot 1 (route work/qa/sv/route.txt): 'P00.00 The quick brown' from x=120, drawn on past the box edge to the screen edge (work/qa/sv/f001440.png)

effect.what: partner effect panel (script/effect, read by 0x080A3618) on the party / assort screen (アソート変更): 8x8 font, 8-px VWF, pen 0 at x=160, box border at x=237, 2 lines
effect.shot: m1_party marker build, state after warp + route (a, down, a, down, a, right, a): 'E00.00 The qu' ink x=160-233, 'i' drawn over the border at 237 (work/qa/sh_m1_party/run/f000540.png). The other reader 0x0809CC54 (from 0x09E9BA) not yet seen

name_var.what: {p} / {s}: the player-entered hero / heroine name, inserted at run time; counted at this width in a line
name_var.shot: name entry takes 7 chars (work/qa/namelen3: the 8th A confirms); kana draw at 12 px in a line ('|{p}|' with the default メイン = 36 px, work/qa/pvar), so 7 x 12. The JP keeps the same room (<= 9 other chars beside {p})
